subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

A wise king’s wisdom _____________the land like the sun.
solution:
The correct answer is **'illuminates'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **given sentence points** out how the wisdom of a wise king has the same effect on the kingdom as the sun. 
 
• So, we need to fill the given blank which would reflect what the sun does which is to shine on
